## Quick Overview: 4-Tier Progressive Plugin Model

| Tier | Capabilities | Required Files | Runtime Cost |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tier 0: Declarative** | Themes, CSS variables, JSON Schema settings, static slash commands, prompt templates, MCP configs | `.vibex-plugin/plugin.json` (+ optional `style.css`, `skills/*/SKILL.md`) | **Zero JS / Zero Process** |
| **Tier 1: UI & Hook Plugin** | Custom UI slots, panels, tabs, kanban views, markdown codeblock renderers, `beforeTurn` / `afterTurn` hooks, `captureInternalMessage`, IoC services, 1-hop `ctx.host.*` RPC | `.vibex-plugin/plugin.json` + `index.js` (or `index.ts`) | **Zero Child Process** (runs in WebView with `PluginErrorBoundary` + `EffectScope`) |
| **Tier 2: Shared Node Worker** | Pure Node.js background handlers (`fs`, `crypto`, data pipelines) | `.vibex-plugin/plugin.json` + `worker/index.mjs` (`"sharedWorker": true`) | **Shared Single Node Host Process** (`vm.SourceTextModule` + `AbortController` + `AsyncLocalStorage`) |
| **Tier 3: Isolated Process / Sidecar** | Native addons, custom Python/binary runtimes, long-lived CLI/daemon child processes (`ctx.host.exec.spawn`) | `.vibex-plugin/plugin.json` + `worker/index.mjs` (`"isolation": "process"`) | **Dedicated OS Process** with automatic lifecycle cleanup |

```ts
export interface RegistryEntry {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly pluginId?: string;
  readonly order?: number;
}

/**
 * Reactive, snapshot-cached contribution registry compatible with React's
 * `useSyncExternalStore`. Mutations produce a new frozen array reference;
 * reads between mutations return the exact same array reference.
 */
export class Registry<T extends RegistryEntry> {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, T>();
  private readonly listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private snapshot: readonly T[] = Object.freeze([]);
  private readonly slotSnapshots = new Map<string, readonly T[]>();

  readonly subscribe = (listener: () => void): Disposer => {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  };

  readonly getAll = (): readonly T[] => {
    return this.snapshot;
  };

  readonly getSnapshot = (): readonly T[] => {
    return this.snapshot;
  };

  getIds(): readonly string[] {
    return this.snapshot.map((item) => item.id);
  }

  get(id: string): T | undefined {
    const direct = this.items.get(id);
    if (direct) return direct;
    for (const item of this.items.values()) {
      if (item.pluginId && `${item.pluginId}:${item.id}` === id) {
        return item;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  has(id: string): boolean {
    return this.get(id) !== undefined;
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.items.size;
  }

  getBySlot(slot: string): readonly T[] {
    const cached = this.slotSnapshots.get(slot);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }
    const aliases = matchingSlotAliases(slot);
    const filtered = Object.freeze(
      this.snapshot.filter((item) => {
        const candidate = (item as unknown as { slot?: string }).slot;
        return typeof candidate === 'string' && aliases.has(candidate);
      })
    );
    this.slotSnapshots.set(slot, filtered);
    return filtered;
  }

  register(item: T, pluginId?: string): Disposer;
  register(id: string, item: T, pluginId?: string): Disposer;
  register(
    idOrItem: string | T,
    itemOrPluginId?: T | string,
    maybePluginId?: string
  ): Disposer {
    const item: T =
      typeof idOrItem === 'string'
        ? { ...(itemOrPluginId as T), id: idOrItem }
        : idOrItem;
    const pluginId =
      typeof idOrItem === 'string'
        ? maybePluginId
        : (itemOrPluginId as string | undefined);
    const normalized: T =
      pluginId && !item.pluginId ? { ...item, pluginId } : item;
    this.items.set(normalized.id, normalized);
    this.rebuildSnapshot();
    this.emit();
    return () => {
      if (this.items.get(normalized.id) === normalized) {
        this.items.delete(normalized.id);
        this.rebuildSnapshot();
        this.emit();
      }
    };
  }

  unregister(id: string): boolean {
    const deleted = this.items.delete(id);
    if (deleted) {
      this.rebuildSnapshot();
      this.emit();
    }
    return deleted;
  }

  unregisterByPlugin(pluginId: string): number {
    let removed = 0;
    for (const [id, item] of this.items.entries()) {
      if (item.pluginId === pluginId) {
        this.items.delete(id);
        removed += 1;
      }
    }
    if (removed > 0) {
      this.rebuildSnapshot();
      this.emit();
    }
    return removed;
  }

  readonly clearByPlugin = (pluginId: string): number => {
    return this.unregisterByPlugin(pluginId);
  };

  clear(): void {
    if (this.items.size === 0) {
      return;
    }
    this.items.clear();
    this.rebuildSnapshot();
    this.emit();
  }

  private rebuildSnapshot(): void {
    const next = Array.from(this.items.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      const orderDiff = (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0);
      if (orderDiff !== 0) {
        return orderDiff;
      }
      return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
    });
    this.snapshot = Object.freeze(next);
    this.slotSnapshots.clear();
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const listener of Array.from(this.listeners)) {
      try {
        listener();
      } catch {
        // Isolate subscriber errors so one broken listener cannot stall others.
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Cordis-Style IoC Service Container & EffectScope (`services.ts`)

Dependency injection (`provide`, `inject`, `require`, `onChange`), reversible `EffectScope` disposers, and waterfall hook interceptors (`intercept`, `runWaterfall`).

```ts
export interface ServiceKey<T> {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly __type?: T;
}

export function createServiceKey<T>(id: string): ServiceKey<T>;

export type WaterfallInterceptor<TPayload, TResult> = (
  payload: TPayload,
  next: (modifiedPayload: TPayload) => Promise<TResult>
) => Promise<TResult>;

/**
 * Cordis-inspired cross-plugin service container with owner-scoped auto-revocation,
 * multi-dependency reactive `inject(deps, effect)`, and onion-model waterfall interceptors
 * with per-hook timeout degradation.
 */
export class ServiceContainer {
  private readonly services = new Map<string, ProvidedServiceRecord>();
  private readonly listeners = new Map<string, Set<() => void>>();
  private readonly globalListeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private readonly interceptors = new Map<string, InterceptorEntry[]>();
  private readonly pluginOwnedDisposers = new Map<string, Set<Disposer>>();

  provide<T>(
    key: ServiceKey<T> | string,
    implementation: T,
    ownerPluginId?: string
  ): Disposer {
    const id = normalizeServiceId(key);
    const record: ProvidedServiceRecord = {
      id,
      ownerPluginId,
      value: implementation,
    };
    this.services.set(id, record);
    this.notify(id);
    return () => {
      if (this.services.get(id) === record) {
        this.services.delete(id);
        this.notify(id);
      }
    };
  }

  get<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T | undefined {
    return this.inject(key);
  }

  inject<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T | undefined;
  inject(
    deps: ReadonlyArray<ServiceKey<unknown> | string>,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    effect: (resolved: any) => void | Disposer,
    ownerPluginId?: string
  ): Disposer;
  inject<T>(
    keyOrDeps:
      | ServiceKey<T>
      | string
      | ReadonlyArray<ServiceKey<unknown> | string>,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    effect?: (resolved: any) => void | Disposer,
    ownerPluginId?: string
  ): T | undefined | Disposer {
    if (!Array.isArray(keyOrDeps)) {
      const id = normalizeServiceId(keyOrDeps as ServiceKey<T> | string);
      return this.services.get(id)?.value as T | undefined;
    }

    if (typeof effect !== 'function') {
      throw new Error(
        'ServiceContainer.inject(deps, effect) requires an effect callback when deps is an array'
      );
    }

    const depIds = keyOrDeps.map((dep) => normalizeServiceId(dep));
    let currentCleanup: void | Disposer;
    let disposed = false;

    const evaluate = () => {
      if (disposed) {
        return;
      }
      if (typeof currentCleanup === 'function') {
        const prev = currentCleanup;
        currentCleanup = undefined;
        try {
          prev();
        } catch {
          // Isolate effect cleanup errors.
        }
      }
      if (depIds.every((id) => this.services.has(id))) {
        const resolved: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const id of depIds) {
          resolved[id] = this.services.get(id)?.value;
        }
        Object.defineProperty(resolved, Symbol.iterator, {
          enumerable: false,
          value: function* () {
            for (const id of depIds) {
              yield resolved[id];
            }
          },
        });
        try {
          currentCleanup = effect(
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
            resolved as Record<string, any> & Iterable<any>
          );
        } catch {
          // Isolate effect execution errors.
        }
      }
    };

    const unsubs = depIds.map((id) => this.onServiceChange(id, evaluate));
    evaluate();

    const disposer: Disposer = () => {
      if (disposed) {
        return;
      }
      disposed = true;
      for (const unsub of unsubs) {
        unsub();
      }
      if (typeof currentCleanup === 'function') {
        const prev = currentCleanup;
        currentCleanup = undefined;
        try {
          prev();
        } catch {
          // Isolate cleanup errors.
        }
      }
      if (ownerPluginId) {
        this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId)?.delete(disposer);
      }
    };

    if (ownerPluginId) {
      let owned = this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId);
      if (!owned) {
        owned = new Set();
        this.pluginOwnedDisposers.set(ownerPluginId, owned);
      }
      owned.add(disposer);
    }

    return disposer;
  }

  require<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T {
    const value = this.inject(key);
    if (value === undefined) {
      throw new Error(
        `Required plugin service "${normalizeServiceId(key)}" is not available`
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  has<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): boolean {
    return this.services.has(normalizeServiceId(key));
  }

  intercept<TPayload = unknown, TResult = unknown>(
    hookName: string,
    fn:
      | WaterfallInterceptor<TPayload, TResult>
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      | ((previousService: any) => any),
    order = 0,
    ownerPluginId?: string
  ): Disposer {
    if (this.services.has(hookName) && fn.length <= 1) {
      const prevRecord = this.services.get(hookName)!;
      const decoratedValue = (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        fn as (previousService: any) => any
      )(prevRecord.value);
      const nextRecord: ProvidedServiceRecord = {
        id: hookName,
        ownerPluginId: ownerPluginId ?? prevRecord.ownerPluginId,
        value: decoratedValue,
      };
      this.services.set(hookName, nextRecord);
      this.notify(hookName);
      const disposer: Disposer = () => {
        if (this.services.get(hookName) === nextRecord) {
          this.services.set(hookName, prevRecord);
          this.notify(hookName);
        }
        if (ownerPluginId) {
          this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId)?.delete(disposer);
        }
      };
      if (ownerPluginId) {
        let owned = this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId);
        if (!owned) {
          owned = new Set();
          this.pluginOwnedDisposers.set(ownerPluginId, owned);
        }
        owned.add(disposer);
      }
      return disposer;
    }

    let list = this.interceptors.get(hookName);
    if (!list) {
      list = [];
      this.interceptors.set(hookName, list);
    }
    const wrappedFn: WaterfallInterceptor<unknown, unknown> =
      fn.length <= 1
        ? async (payload, next) => {
            const transformed = await (
              fn as (value: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>
            )(payload);
            return await next(
              transformed !== undefined ? transformed : payload
            );
          }
        : (fn as WaterfallInterceptor<unknown, unknown>);
    const entry: InterceptorEntry = {
      ownerPluginId,
      order,
      fn: wrappedFn,
    };
    list.push(entry);
    list.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);

    const disposer: Disposer = () => {
      const current = this.interceptors.get(hookName);
      if (!current) {
        return;
      }
      const idx = current.indexOf(entry);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        current.splice(idx, 1);
      }
      if (current.length === 0) {
        this.interceptors.delete(hookName);
      }
      if (ownerPluginId) {
        this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId)?.delete(disposer);
      }
    };

    if (ownerPluginId) {
      let owned = this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(ownerPluginId);
      if (!owned) {
        owned = new Set();
        this.pluginOwnedDisposers.set(ownerPluginId, owned);
      }
      owned.add(disposer);
    }

    return disposer;
  }

  hasInterceptors(hookName: string): boolean {
    const entries = this.interceptors.get(hookName);
    return Boolean(entries && entries.length > 0);
  }

  async runWaterfall<TPayload, TResult = TPayload>(
    hookName: string,
    initialPayload: TPayload,
    terminal: (payload: TPayload) => Promise<TResult> | TResult = (payload) =>
      payload as unknown as TResult,
    perHookTimeoutMs = 1500
  ): Promise<TResult> {
    const chain = [...(this.interceptors.get(hookName) ?? [])];
    const dispatch = async (
      index: number,
      currentPayload: TPayload
    ): Promise<TResult> => {
      if (index >= chain.length) {
        return await terminal(currentPayload);
      }
      const current = chain[index]!;
      let nextCalled = false;
      const invokeHook = current.fn(currentPayload, async (nextPayload) => {
        if (nextCalled) {
          throw new Error('waterfall next() called multiple times');
        }
        nextCalled = true;
        return await dispatch(
          index + 1,
          (nextPayload !== undefined ? nextPayload : currentPayload) as TPayload
        );
      }) as Promise<TResult>;

      let timeoutHandle: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      const timeoutFallback = new Promise<TResult>((resolve, reject) => {
        timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!nextCalled) {
            dispatch(index + 1, currentPayload).then(resolve, reject);
          }
        }, perHookTimeoutMs);
      });

      try {
        return await Promise.race([invokeHook, timeoutFallback]);
      } catch {
        if (!nextCalled) {
          return await dispatch(index + 1, currentPayload);
        }
        throw new Error(`Waterfall hook "${hookName}" failed after next()`);
      } finally {
        if (timeoutHandle !== undefined) {
          clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
        }
      }
    };

    return await dispatch(0, initialPayload);
  }

  async emitParallel<TPayload>(
    hookName: string,
    payload: TPayload
  ): Promise<void> {
    const chain = [...(this.interceptors.get(hookName) ?? [])];
    await Promise.allSettled(
      chain.map((entry) =>
        Promise.resolve().then(() =>
          entry.fn(payload, async (nextPayload) => nextPayload ?? payload)
        )
      )
    );
  }

  onServiceChange<T>(
    key: ServiceKey<T> | string,
    listener: () => void
  ): Disposer {
    const id = normalizeServiceId(key);
    let set = this.listeners.get(id);
    if (!set) {
      set = new Set();
      this.listeners.set(id, set);
    }
    set.add(listener);
    return () => {
      set?.delete(listener);
      if (set && set.size === 0) {
        this.listeners.delete(id);
      }
    };
  }

  subscribe(listener: () => void): Disposer {
    this.globalListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.globalListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  disposeByPlugin(pluginId: string): number {
    let removedCount = 0;

    const ownedDisposers = this.pluginOwnedDisposers.get(pluginId);
    if (ownedDisposers) {
      this.pluginOwnedDisposers.delete(pluginId);
      for (const disposer of Array.from(ownedDisposers)) {
        disposer();
        removedCount += 1;
      }
    }

    for (const [hookName, entries] of this.interceptors.entries()) {
      const before = entries.length;
      const filtered = entries.filter((e) => e.ownerPluginId !== pluginId);
      removedCount += before - filtered.length;
      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        this.interceptors.delete(hookName);
      } else if (filtered.length !== before) {
        this.interceptors.set(hookName, filtered);
      }
    }

    const removedIds: string[] = [];
    for (const [id, record] of this.services.entries()) {
      if (record.ownerPluginId === pluginId) {
        this.services.delete(id);
        removedIds.push(id);
        removedCount += 1;
      }
    }
    for (const id of removedIds) {
      this.notify(id);
    }
    return removedCount;
  }

  disposePlugin(pluginId: string): number {
    return this.disposeByPlugin(pluginId);
  }

  clear(): void {
    for (const disposers of this.pluginOwnedDisposers.values()) {
      for (const disposer of Array.from(disposers)) {
        disposer();
      }
    }
    this.pluginOwnedDisposers.clear();
    this.interceptors.clear();
    const ids = Array.from(this.services.keys());
    this.services.clear();
    for (const id of ids) {
      this.notify(id);
    }
  }

  private notify(id: string): void {
    const set = this.listeners.get(id);
    if (set) {
      for (const listener of Array.from(set)) {
        try {
          listener();
        } catch {
          // Isolate listener failures.
        }
      }
    }
    for (const listener of Array.from(this.globalListeners)) {
      try {
        listener();
      } catch {
        // Isolate listener failures.
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Tracks reversible side effects (disposers) for one plugin activation fiber
 * and tears them down in LIFO order on deactivation/HMR.
 */
export class EffectScope {
  private readonly disposers: Disposer[] = [];
  private disposed = false;

  get isDisposed(): boolean {
    return this.disposed;
  }

  addDisposer(disposer: Disposer): Disposer {
    if (this.disposed) {
      try {
        disposer();
      } catch {
        // Ignore late disposer errors.
      }
      return () => {};
    }
    this.disposers.push(disposer);
    return () => {
      const idx = this.disposers.indexOf(disposer);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        this.disposers.splice(idx, 1);
        try {
          disposer();
        } catch {
          // Isolate disposer errors.
        }
      }
    };
  }

  effect(setup: () => void | Disposer): Disposer {
    if (this.disposed) {
      return () => {};
    }
    const cleanup = setup();
    if (typeof cleanup === 'function') {
      return this.addDisposer(cleanup);
    }
    return () => {};
  }

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) {
      return;
    }
    this.disposed = true;
    const pending = this.disposers.splice(0, this.disposers.length).reverse();
    for (const disposer of pending) {
      try {
        disposer();
      } catch {
        // Ensure every disposer runs even if one throws.
      }
    }
  }
}

export const serviceContainer: ServiceContainer =
  getOrCreateGlobalServiceContainer();

export const globalServices: ServiceContainer = serviceContainer;
```

## Backend Node Worker Runtime (`worker.ts`)

Tier-2 / Tier-3 Node Worker definition (`definePluginWorker`, `PluginWorkerContext`, Host capability calls).

```ts
export interface Disposable {
  dispose(): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface PluginHostClient {
  call<T extends JsonValue = JsonValue>(
    capability: string,
    operation: string,
    input?: JsonValue
  ): Promise<T>;
}

export interface PluginWorkerServiceRegistry {
  provide<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string, implementation: T): Disposer;
  get<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T | undefined;
  inject<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T | undefined;
  inject(
    deps: ReadonlyArray<ServiceKey<unknown> | string>,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    effect: (resolved: any) => void | Disposer
  ): Disposer;
  require<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): T;
  has<T>(key: ServiceKey<T> | string): boolean;
  intercept<TPayload = unknown, TResult = unknown>(
    hookName: string,
    fn:
      | WaterfallInterceptor<TPayload, TResult>
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      | ((previousService: any) => any),
    order?: number
  ): Disposer;
  runWaterfall<TPayload, TResult>(
    hookName: string,
    initialPayload: TPayload,
    terminal: (payload: TPayload) => Promise<TResult>,
    perHookTimeoutMs?: number
  ): Promise<TResult>;
  subscribe(listener: () => void): Disposer;
}

export function createWorkerServiceRegistry(
  pluginId: string,
  container: ServiceContainer = serviceContainer
): PluginWorkerServiceRegistry;

export interface PluginWorkerEnvironment {
  context: PluginContext;
  host: PluginHostClient;
  services: PluginWorkerServiceRegistry;
  signal: AbortSignal;
  log: {
    debug(message: string, fields?: JsonValue): void;
    info(message: string, fields?: JsonValue): void;
    warn(message: string, fields?: JsonValue): void;
    error(message: string, fields?: JsonValue): void;
  };
}

export function normalizePluginContext(
  context: Partial<PluginContext> &
    Pick<PluginContext, 'pluginId' | 'pluginVersion' | 'generation'>
): PluginContext;

export type PluginHandler = (
  input: JsonValue,
  environment: PluginWorkerEnvironment
) => JsonValue | Promise<JsonValue>;

export interface PluginWorkerRegistrar {
  handle(id: string, handler: PluginHandler): void;
  onDispose(disposable: Disposable | (() => void | Promise<void>)): void;
}

export interface PluginWorkerDefinition {
  readonly apiVersion: '1.0';
  readonly setup: (
    registrar: PluginWorkerRegistrar,
    environment: PluginWorkerEnvironment
  ) => void | Disposable | Promise<void | Disposable>;
}

export interface ActivatedPluginWorker extends Disposable {
  readonly handlers: readonly string[];
  invoke(handler: string, input: JsonValue): Promise<JsonValue>;
}

export function definePluginWorker(
  setup: PluginWorkerDefinition['setup']
): PluginWorkerDefinition;

export async function activatePluginWorker(
  definition: PluginWorkerDefinition,
  environment: Omit<PluginWorkerEnvironment, 'signal' | 'services'> & {
    services?: PluginWorkerServiceRegistry;
  }
): Promise<ActivatedPluginWorker>;

export class PluginSdkError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: string,
    message: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PluginSdkError';
  }
}
```

## App Surface Bridge (`app.ts`)

App surface mount API (`definePluginApp`, `VibeXAppBridge`, 1-hop `bridge.hostCall`).

```ts
export interface ArtifactTextDocument {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly content: string;
  readonly revision: string;
}

export interface ArtifactWriteResult {
  readonly revision: string;
}

export interface VibeXArtifactEditorBridge {
  readonly name: string;
  readText(): Promise<ArtifactTextDocument>;
  writeText(
    content: string,
    expectedRevision: string
  ): Promise<ArtifactWriteResult>;
}

export interface VibeXAppBridge {
  readonly pluginId: string;
  readonly generation: number;
  /** Present only when this App is mounted in an `artifact.editor` file tab. */
  readonly artifact?: VibeXArtifactEditorBridge;
  invoke<T extends JsonValue = JsonValue>(
    handler: string,
    input?: JsonValue
  ): Promise<T>;
  /** Direct 1-hop Host Capability Broker call without spawning a Node Worker. */
  hostCall?<T extends JsonValue = JsonValue>(
    capability: string,
    operation: string,
    input?: JsonValue
  ): Promise<T>;
  subscribe(
    channel: string,
    listener: (payload: JsonValue) => void
  ): () => void;
  ready(): void;
}

export interface PluginAppEnvironment {
  bridge: VibeXAppBridge;
  root: HTMLElement;
  signal: AbortSignal;
  /** Contribution slot that mounted this document, when the Host provided one. */
  slot?: string;
}

export interface PluginAppDefinition {
  readonly apiVersion: '1.0';
  readonly mount: (
    environment: PluginAppEnvironment
  ) =>
    | void
    | (() => void | Promise<void>)
    | Promise<void | (() => void | Promise<void>)>;
}

export function definePluginApp(
  mount: PluginAppDefinition['mount']
): PluginAppDefinition;
```

## Plugin Manifest Schema (`manifest.ts`)

Manifest types and helpers for `.vibex-plugin/plugin.json` (`apiVersion: "2.0"` and `"1.0"`).

```ts
/** Public authoring contract for a VibeX product plugin. */
export interface VibeXPluginManifest {
  $schema?: string;
  manifestVersion: 4;
  apiVersion: "1.0";
  id: string;
  publisher: string;
  version: string;
  name: string;
  /** Always points to the required root README. Its frontmatter owns `summary`. */
  readme: "README.md";
  engines: { vibex: string; pluginSdk: string };
  content: {
    root: "contents";
    index: ".vibex-plugin/content.index.json";
  };
  /** Values live in root config.json; this schema only describes and validates them. */
  config: { schema: Record<string, unknown> };
  dependencies?: DependencyManifest[];
  entrypoints?: {
    worker?: WorkerEntrypointManifest;
    app?: AppEntrypointManifest;
  };
  permissions?: PermissionManifest[];
  integrations: IntegrationManifest[];
  interface?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type WorkerRuntime = "node" | "python" | "native";

export interface WorkerEntrypointManifest {
  path: string;
  runtime: WorkerRuntime;
  protocol: "1.1";
}

export interface AppEntrypointManifest {
  root: string;
  document: string;
  protocol: "1.0";
}

export interface PermissionManifest {
  /** @deprecated Full-trust packages do not require capability consent. */
  id: string;
  capability: string;
  scope: Record<string, unknown>;
  reason: string;
  optional?: boolean;
  /** @deprecated Retained only so v4 packages authored before full trust remain valid. */
  trustTier?: "sandboxed_worker" | "trusted_native";
}

export interface DependencyManifest {
  kind: "runtime" | "plugin";
  descriptor: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

export interface SkillIntegrationManifest extends IntegrationBase {
  kind: "content.skill";
  resource: string;
  targets?: string[];
}

export interface McpIntegrationManifest extends IntegrationBase {
  kind: "content.mcp";
  resource: string;
}

/** One tool the Host MCP manager lists before an agent session connects. */
export interface PluginMcpToolDeclaration {
  name: string;
  group?: string;
}

/** Package-relative MCP process supervised and credentialed by the VibeX Host. */
export interface ManagedMcpRuntimeResource {
  managedRuntime: {
    /** Authoring source bundled by the Plugin CLI into `entrypoint`. */
    source?: string;
    /** STDIO entrypoint. Forbidden when `kind` is `workerHttp`. */
    entrypoint?: string;
    kind?: "hostFamilyBinary" | "workerHttp";
    /** Worker handler that returns `{ url, headers }` for `kind: workerHttp`. */
    handler?: string;
    binaryId?: string;
    protocolRevision: "2026-07-28";
    defaultBinding?: "all-compatible-agents";
  };
  /** Required for packaged/static/workerHttp MCP so the status bar can list tools. */
  tools?: Array<string | PluginMcpToolDeclaration>;
}

export interface WorkflowIntegrationManifest extends IntegrationBase {
  kind: "workflow.binding";
  resource: string;
}

export interface FileOpenerIntegrationManifest extends IntegrationBase {
  kind: "file.opener";
  label?: string;
  extensions?: string[];
  /** Exact case-insensitive filename suffixes, including the leading dot. */

  mediaTypes?: string[];
  priority?: number;
  /** Runtime-backed URL preview. Exactly one opener target is required. */
  previewProvider?: string;
  /** App surface mounted as an editable file tab. Exactly one opener target is required. */

}

export interface PreviewIntegrationManifest extends IntegrationBase {

export const pluginManifestSchema = {
  $schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  $id: "https://schemas.vibex.dev/plugin/v4/plugin.schema.json",
  type: "object",
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: [
    "manifestVersion",
    "apiVersion",
    "id",
    "publisher",
    "version",
    "name",
    "readme",
    "engines",
    "content",
    "config",
    "integrations",
  ],
  properties: {
    $schema: { type: "string" },
    manifestVersion: { const: 4 },
    apiVersion: { const: "1.0" },
    id: { type: "string", pattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,62}$" },
    publisher: { type: "string", pattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,62}$" },
    version: {
      type: "string",
      pattern:
        "^(0|[1-9]\\d*)\\.(0|[1-9]\\d*)\\.(0|[1-9]\\d*)(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$",
    },
    name: { type: "string", minLength: 1 },
    readme: { const: "README.md" },
    engines: {
      type: "object",
      additionalProperties: false,
      required: ["vibex", "pluginSdk"],
      properties: {
        vibex: { type: "string", minLength: 1 },
        pluginSdk: { type: "string", minLength: 1 },
      },
    },
    content: {
      type: "object",
      additionalProperties: false,
      required: ["root", "index"],
      properties: {
        root: { const: "contents" },
        index: { const: ".vibex-plugin/content.index.json" },
      },
    },
    config: {
      type: "object",
      additionalProperties: false,
      required: ["schema"],
      properties: { schema: { type: "object" } },
    },
    dependencies: {
      type: "array",
      items: {
        type: "object",
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ["kind", "descriptor"],
        properties: {
          kind: { enum: ["runtime", "plugin"] },
          descriptor: relativePath,
          optional: { type: "boolean" },
        },
      },
    },
    entrypoints: {
      type: "object",
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        worker: {
          type: "object",
          additionalProperties: false,
          required: ["path", "runtime", "protocol"],
          properties: {
            path: relativePath,
            runtime: { enum: ["node", "python", "native"] },
            protocol: { const: "1.1" },
          },
        },
        app: {
          type: "object",
          additionalProperties: false,
          required: ["root", "document", "protocol"],
          properties: {
            root: relativePath,
            document: relativePath,
            protocol: { const: "1.0" },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    permissions: {
      type: "array",
      items: {
        type: "object",
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ["id", "capability", "scope", "reason"],
        properties: {
          id,
          capability: { enum: ["runtime.execute", "artifact.preview"] },
          scope: { type: "object" },
          reason: { type: "string", minLength: 1 },
          optional: { type: "boolean" },
          trustTier: { enum: ["sandboxed_worker", "trusted_native"] },
        },
      },
    },
    integrations: {
      type: "array",
      minItems: 1,
      items: {
        type: "object",
        required: ["id", "kind"],
        properties: {
          id,
          kind: {
            enum: [
              "content.skill",
              "content.mcp",
              "content.hook",
              "workflow.binding",
              "file.opener",
              "artifact.preview",
              "app.surface",
              "app.command",
              "app.toolbar",
              "app.status",
              "app.composer.slash",
              "app.timeline.card",
              "app.settings.section",
              "host.service",
              "provider.model.importSource",
              "provider.model.catalog",
              "app.panel",
              "app.tab",
              "app.kanban.view",
              "app.settings.page",
              "app.composer.action",
              "app.rail.section",
              "provider.remote.provisioner",
            ],
          },
          resource: relativePath,
          required: { type: "boolean" },
        },
      },
    },
    interface: { type: "object" },
  },
} as const;
```

## Wire Protocol & Error Codes (`protocol.ts`)

JSON-RPC wire protocol frames, capability names, and structured `PluginSdkError` definitions.

```ts
export const VIBEX_PLUGIN_API_VERSION = "1.0" as const;

export const VIBEX_PLUGIN_PROTOCOL_VERSION = "1.1" as const;

export const MIN_FRAME_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

export const MAX_FRAME_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;

export const MAX_LOGICAL_MESSAGE_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024;

export const FRAME_CHUNK_METHOD = "frame.chunk";

export type JsonPrimitive = string | number | boolean | null;

export type JsonValue =
  | JsonPrimitive
  | JsonValue[]
  | { [key: string]: JsonValue };

export type PackageClass = "full-trust" | "isolated";

export interface InitializeParams {
  protocolRange: ["1.1"];
  hostVersion: string;
  pluginIdentity: { publisher: string; id: string };
  packageVersion: string;
  packageDigest: string;
  generationId: number;
  declaredContributions: string[];
  packageClass: PackageClass;
  features: string[];
  limits: {
    maxFrameBytes: number;
    maxLogicalMessageBytes?: number;
    requestTimeoutMs: number;
  };
  runtime: { id: string; version: string; target: string; digest: string };
}

export interface InitializedResult {
  protocolVersion: "1.1";
  sdkVersion: string;
  registrations: string[];
  requestedFeatures: string[];
}

export interface PluginContext {
  pluginId: string;
  pluginVersion: string;
  generation: number;
  packageClass: PackageClass;
  grantedCapabilities: string[];
}

export type WorkerRequest =
  | { id: string; method: "initialize"; params: InitializeParams }
  | { id: string; method: "activate"; params: PluginContext }
  | {
      id: string;

export type WorkerResponse =
  | { id: string; ok: true; result: JsonValue }
  | {
      id: string;

export type HostRequest = {
  id: string;
  method: "host.call";
  params: {
    capability: string;
    operation: string;
    input: JsonValue;
  };
};

export type HostResponse = WorkerResponse;

export class ProtocolFrameError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;

  constructor(code: string, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ProtocolFrameError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export interface FrameLimits {
  maxFrameBytes: number;
  maxLogicalBytes: number;
}

export function protocolFrameLimits(): FrameLimits;

/** Limits the Host advertised in initialize. Frame stays inside 1 MiB..=128 MiB. */
export function frameLimitsFromAdvertised(
  maxFrameBytes: number,
  maxLogicalMessageBytes?: number,
): FrameLimits;

/** One JSON line when the message fits. Larger payloads become frame.chunk. */
export function encodeProtocolMessage(
  message: { id?: string },
  limits: FrameLimits = protocolFrameLimits(),
): string[];

export class FrameReassembler {
  private streamId: string | null = null;
  private count = 0;
  private nextIndex = 0;
  private parts: string[] = [];
  private totalBytes = 0;

  constructor(private limits: FrameLimits = protocolFrameLimits()) {}

  setLimits(limits: FrameLimits) {
    if (this.streamId === null) this.limits = limits;
  }

  pushLine(line: string): DecodedFrame {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return { kind: "skip" };
    if (Buffer.byteLength(trimmed, "utf8") > this.limits.maxFrameBytes) {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "frame_too_large",
        "Worker protocol frame exceeded the limit",
      );
    }
    let value: unknown;
    try {
      value = JSON.parse(trimmed);
    } catch {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError("protocol_invalid", "Invalid JSON message");
    }
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "protocol_invalid",
        "Protocol message must be an object",
      );
    }
    const message = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (message.method !== FRAME_CHUNK_METHOD) {
      if (this.streamId !== null) {
        this.reset();
        throw new ProtocolFrameError(
          "frame_chunk_invalid",
          "Chunk sequence was interrupted",
        );
      }
      return { kind: "message", message };
    }
    return this.pushChunk(message);
  }

  private pushChunk(message: Record<string, unknown>): DecodedFrame {
    const params =
      message.params && typeof message.params === "object"
        ? (message.params as Record<string, unknown>)
        : {};
    const streamId = typeof params.streamId === "string" ? params.streamId : "";
    const index = typeof params.index === "number" ? params.index : Number.NaN;
    const count = typeof params.count === "number" ? params.count : Number.NaN;
    const data = typeof params.data === "string" ? params.data : "";
    if (
      !streamId ||
      !data ||
      !Number.isInteger(index) ||
      !Number.isInteger(count) ||
      count <= 0 ||
      index < 0 ||
      index >= count
    ) {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "frame_chunk_invalid",
        "Chunk is missing streamId, index, count, or data",
      );
    }
    if (index === 0) {
      if (this.streamId !== null) {
        this.reset();
        throw new ProtocolFrameError(
          "frame_chunk_invalid",
          "Chunk sequence was interrupted",
        );
      }
      this.streamId = streamId;
      this.count = count;
      this.nextIndex = 0;
      this.parts = [];
      this.totalBytes = 0;
    }
    if (
      this.streamId !== streamId ||
      index !== this.nextIndex ||
      count !== this.count
    ) {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "frame_chunk_invalid",
        "Chunk index or count does not match the sequence",
      );
    }
    this.totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(data, "utf8");
    if (this.totalBytes > this.limits.maxLogicalBytes) {
      this.reset();
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "message_too_large",
        `message exceeds ${this.limits.maxLogicalBytes} bytes`,
      );
    }
    this.parts.push(data);
    this.nextIndex += 1;
    if (this.nextIndex < this.count) return { kind: "skip" };
    const logical = this.parts.join("");
    const expectedId = streamId;
    this.reset();
    let assembled: unknown;
    try {
      assembled = JSON.parse(logical);
    } catch {
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "protocol_invalid",
        "Reassembled message is not JSON",
      );
    }
    if (
      !assembled ||
      typeof assembled !== "object" ||
      Array.isArray(assembled) ||
      (assembled as { id?: unknown }).id !== expectedId
    ) {
      throw new ProtocolFrameError(
        "frame_chunk_invalid",
        "Reassembled message id does not match the chunk stream",
      );
    }
    return {
      kind: "message",
      message: assembled as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
  }

  private reset() {
    this.streamId = null;
    this.count = 0;
    this.nextIndex = 0;
    this.parts = [];
    this.totalBytes = 0;
  }
}
```
